result.summary: The page renders overall correctly; the main visible defect is in the bottom navigation where the Orders tab lacks an icon while the other tabs have one. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The bottom navigation 'Orders' tab shows only a text label and no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile which each have an icon above the label. This creates an inconsistent nav bar.
issues.suggestion: Add an Orders/receipt icon aligned with the other tab icons, or remove icons from all tabs for a consistent text-only style.
